description: Home tab, agent list and detail, ownership markers, conflict warnings and combined review for several AI agents. A thin client of synapse-core.
cmd.steerAgent: Add Guidance While an Agent Works…
cmd.takeover: Hand Work Off to Another Agent…
cmd.openWorktree: Open Agent Worktree in New Window
config.autoStartCore: Start synapse-core automatically when a git repository is open.
config.corePath: Path to synapse-core's main script. Empty: use the core bundled with this extension.
config.nodePath: Node.js binary used to run synapse-core. Empty: the editor's own runtime.
config.showInlineOwners: Show which agent is changing a symbol at the end of its first line.
config.showWalkthroughOnStart: Open the Synapse walkthrough when a repository is opened. The home tab's Get started list covers the same steps.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Synapse
walkthrough.description: Run several AI agents in one repository without them breaking each other's work.
walkthrough.config.title: Configure the workspace
walkthrough.config.description:
Tell Synapse how to test the combined result and where to keep the decision log.
[Create synapse.config.json](command:synapse.initConfig)
walkthrough.agents.title: Add two agents
walkthrough.agents.description:
Each agent gets its own git worktree and branch. Claude needs your ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; Codex uses your OPENAI_API_KEY or Codex sign-in.
[Add an agent](command:synapse.addAgent)
walkthrough.tasks.title: Split the work into tasks
walkthrough.tasks.description:
Assign tasks to agents and set dependencies. Finished work is handed to the next agent with what it changed.
[New task](command:synapse.newTask)
walkthrough.conflicts.title: Watch for conflicts
walkthrough.conflicts.description:
Code another agent is changing is tinted in its color; conflicts show in the Problems panel before anything is merged.
[Open home](command:synapse.openHome)
walkthrough.policy.title: Decide what agents may do
walkthrough.policy.description:
Edits in their own worktree are allowed; commands not on the allow list come to you.
[Edit a policy](command:synapse.editPolicy)
walkthrough.review.title: Review and merge in one pass
walkthrough.review.description:
Merge every agent's work in a scratch worktree, run your tests on the combined result, then merge.
[Combined review](command:synapse.prepareReview)
config.openHomeOnStart: Open the Synapse home tab when a repository is opened.
config.notifications.approvals: Desktop notification when an agent asks for approval while the window is in the background.
config.notifications.errors: Desktop notification when an agent stops with an error while the window is in the background.
config.notifications.finished: Desktop notification when an agent finishes a task while the window is in the background.
color.cardBackground: Background of cards in Synapse views.
color.cardBorder: Border of cards in Synapse views.
color.raisedBackground: Background of selected rows and raised surfaces in Synapse views.
color.subtleForeground: Least prominent text in Synapse views, such as line numbers.
color.statusReview: Synapse: work is ready for review.
color.statusError: Synapse: a conflict or an error.
config.workbenchFont: Use Synapse's font (Pretendard) for the workbench. Off: the system font.
config.autoHideAgentColumn: Hide the agent column (secondary side bar) when the window is narrower than 1280 pixels, and show it again when it is wider. Opened in a narrow window, it shows as a drawer over the editor area.
cmd.focusGuidance: Give Guidance to the Selected Agent
cmd.reviewAgent: Ask an Agent to Review Another's Changes…
